title: Sports Complex
content: The sports complex is located near the h block, the stairs down from it will lead you to sports complex area.

title: Gym
content: VVCE provides gym facilities for students interested in fitness and physical training. For access details and timings, contact the main office.

title: Sports offered
content: VVCE has a strong sporting culture featuring a large ground for cricket, basketball and football, and an indoor dedicated Sports Complex, and a well-equipped gym. The college frequently wins VTU-level championships in volleyball, football, and kabaddi.
